issues.title: [superagent] Recovery, Plugin load fix: commit the browser-safe locked-escalation list as a PR, ready to review
issues.body:
@gera3d

Why it matters to Gera: after the restart the Superagent plugin failed to load ("import failed ... require(\"node:child_process\") missed the module table"). A source fix is sitting uncommitted in the live folder and Gera confirmed the page now loads. It must land in GitHub so the next pull does not undo it or conflict with it.

## Cause
The merged Characters panel imports `LOCKED_ESCALATION_LIST` from `src/policy.ts` via `src/client/api.ts`. `policy.ts` pulls in server-only code (`infra/environment.ts`, which leads to `node:child_process`), so the browser bundle tried to load a Node module.

## The live, uncommitted fix (in `default-workspace/dsh-superagent`)
- New file `src/locked-escalation.ts`: the `LockedEscalationItem` type and the `LOCKED_ESCALATION_LIST` constant, moved out of `policy.ts`, no server imports.
- `src/policy.ts`: the block is replaced by `export { LOCKED_ESCALATION_LIST, type LockedEscalationItem } from './locked-escalation.ts'`.
- `src/client/api.ts`: now imports the list and type from `../locked-escalation.ts` instead of `../policy.ts`.

## What to do
1. In `gera3d/dsh-superagent-prototype`, branch from `superagent-core` and apply exactly that fix. Take the patch from the live working tree (`git diff` plus the new file) and keep a backup copy of that patch in the work folder. Do not discard or reset anything in the live checkout.
2. Add a guard test that fails if any file under `src/client` (directly or through its imports) reaches `node:` modules or server-only files, so this cannot happen again. A simple import-graph check in vitest is enough.
3. Run `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build` and the test suites. Confirm `grep -c 'node:child_process' lib/client.js` is 0 in the built client.
4. Open a PR against `superagent-core`. Do not merge it; the operator merges.

## Do not
- No restart, no apply, no live changes, no `pnpm build` into the live folder. PR only.
- No agent may run `dsh-superagent stop` or `restart`, `kill` or `tmux kill-session` the harness, or set `DSH_SUPERAGENT_ALLOW_SELF_RESTART`.
- No key, secret, or model-setting changes.

## Done means
One comment here with the PR link, the patch backup path, test results, the child_process check, and a 3-line try-it checklist.

Gera confirmed by voice on 2026-11-04 that the live page loads with this fix.

This is by an automated agent task filed for Gera, not a human.

@gera3d Why it matters to Gera: the white 57 logo can't show today. Two bugs found live on 2026-11-05 and already patched by hand in the live folder (uncommitted); they need to be in GitHub so a later pull doesn't undo them. ## The two bugs 1. `src/client/branding-mark.tsx`: `BrandLogoMark` calls `fetch('/orchestrator/api/branding')` without the `x-orchestrator-request: 1` header, so the server answers 403 'Same-origin management request required' and the mark always falls back to the DeepSeek fish. `, so Save does nothing. Let that one route require only a loopback Host header (`127.0.0.1:` or `localhost:`), keep the rest as is. 4. Add tests: the mark sends the header; Save submits and persists; the raw route serves with only a loopback Host and refuses other hosts. Base is `superagent-core` in `gera3d/dsh-superagent-prototype`. The live folder's uncommitted diff for items 1-2 is just the two one-line changes above; do not copy anything else from the live folder. ## Do not - No restart, no apply, no live changes.
